# The Pagan Law Firm

> Top-rated New York personal injury law firm specializing in medical malpractice, birth injuries, and wrongful death cases.

The Pagan Law Firm is a New York City-based personal injury law firm led by experienced attorneys Tania M. Pagan and William Pagan, offering comprehensive legal representation for medical negligence, birth injuries, and accident cases across NYC and surrounding areas.
